guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 波傳播、邊界反射與輸水瞬變驗證。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Wave propagation, boundary reflections and water-main transient verification. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、D=1 m、v=2 m/s、f=0.020、g=9.81 m/s²，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m，未含局部損失。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水K=2.2 GPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、鋼E=200 GPa、D=1 m、t=0.010 m，a=√[K/{ρ(1+KD/Et)}]=1023.5 m/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、a=1000 m/s、減速幅度Δv=1.0 m/s，壓升幅度Δp=ρaΔv=1.00 MPa；ΔH=Δp/(ρg)=101.94 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設均勻管長L=5000 m、波速a=1000 m/s，往返時間Tr=2L/a=10.0 s；關閥時間Tc=3 s時，Tc/Tr=0.30。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、v0=1 m/s、Tc=30 s、g=9.81 m/s²，慢變比較ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m；此例Tr=10 s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設I=100 kg·m²、ω=100 rad/s，E=Iω²/2=500 kJ；若比較功率P=100 kW，E/P=5.0 s，非停泵預測。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, D=1 m, v=2 m/s, f=0.020 and g=9.81 m/s²; hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m, excluding local losses.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water K=2.2 GPa, ρ=1000 kg/m³, steel E=200 GPa, D=1 m and t=0.010 m; a=√[K/{ρ(1+KD/Et)}]=1023.5 m/s.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, a=1000 m/s and deceleration magnitude Δv=1.0 m/s. Surge magnitude Δp=ρaΔv=1.00 MPa and ΔH=Δp/(ρg)=101.94 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume uniform length L=5000 m and speed a=1000 m/s. Round-trip time Tr=2L/a=10.0 s; for closure time Tc=3 s, Tc/Tr=0.30.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, v0=1 m/s, Tc=30 s and g=9.81 m/s². A slow-change comparison gives ΔH≈2Lv0/(gTc)=33.98 m, with Tr=10 s in this example.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume I=100 kg·m² and ω=100 rad/s: E=Iω²/2=500 kJ. For comparison power P=100 kW, E/P=5.0 s, not a rundown prediction.
timeline: 1949　墾務局焊接鋼製壓力管專論初版發行；非本課工程開工年。
2020　EPANET第二點二版手冊發布，提供延時管網模型方法。
2025　紐約公告繞道接通重新採購，保留供水與施工協調限制。
timelineEn: 1949 — Reclamation first issues the welded-steel penstock monograph; this is a publication milestone.
2020 — The EPANET 2.2 manual documents extended-period network modeling.
2025 — New York announces renewed bypass-connection procurement, retaining supply and construction constraints.

codesEn: Reclamation Engineering Monograph 3: penstock mechanics and historical design reference

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：長距離輸水管水錘分析
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Water-hammer analysis for long water mains
guides.concept: 本課從穩態水頭線開始，依序分析彈性波速、速度突變、邊界反射、關閉曲線及停泵慣性，再把低壓空穴、氣室熱力、數值網格與疲勞接回完整輸水系統。每個算例都分清初步量級與完整瞬變模型，並要求壓力、流量、閥位及時間基準互相驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Starting with the steady hydraulic grade, this course examines elastic wave speed, velocity changes, reflections, closure shape and pump inertia, then connects cavities, air-vessel thermodynamics, numerical grids and fatigue to the complete water-main system. Each example distinguishes a scale estimate from a complete transient model and checks pressure, flow, valve position and timing against one another.
procedure: 水錘計算的初始狀態必須同時滿足水量與能量守恆，不能任意指定互不相容的流量及兩端水位。長管摩阻、局部閥損與泵揚程共同決定速度，而高程圖決定每處壓力水頭；相同總壓降並不表示沿線最低壓位置相同。本單元的達西公式假設滿管單相穩定流，所給摩阻係數已另行確定；它不能描述壓力波到達前後的瞬間局部加速度。
壓力波速度由水的可壓縮性與管壁徑向柔度共同控制，不能直接使用自由水體的聲速。薄壁鋼管的直徑厚度比越大，壁面變形通常越明顯；錨定、泊松效應、襯層及含氣量則會改變有效柔度和頻散，需與管材模型一起選定。下式為忽略泊松與端部約束修正的簡化彈性薄壁關係，不能直接套用黏彈性塑膠管或有大氣囊的管路。
速度突然改變時，液柱動量藉由壓力波與管壁變形重新分配。焦可夫斯基關係把單一波前兩側的速度變化連到壓力變化，但流向、反射、分岔與既有壓力必須分別保留；算出的增量既不是絕對壓力，也不是全系統各處的最大包絡。此算例假設快速變化、單相液體與已知有效波速，尚未處理空化、水柱分離或多波重疊，不能作閥門操作設定。
閥門看到的壓力歷程取決於波傳到上游邊界再返回的時間，長度與波速共同決定往返尺度。定水頭水庫與封閉端對壓力波具有不同反射條件，分岔還會依阻抗分配波動；把整條管線視為單一長度可能掩蓋支線的較短共振路徑。往返時間只是單一均勻管段的傳播尺度，不是任意管網的完整週期；邊界的動態特性也可能隨閥位與水位改變。
關閥總時間不能完整描述水錘，因為有效流通面積與閥桿位置通常不是線性關係。末段的小位移可能造成最大的流量變化，因此相同總時間的兩條關閉曲線可能有不同峰值；慢變估式適合分辨慣性尺度，不能代替真實閥特性與管線反射。下式只作簡單水庫至閥門管線、假設近似均勻減速且關閉較慢的量級比較；不保證為實際峰值上限，也不是推薦關閉時間。
停電後泵組不會瞬間停止，轉子與液柱慣性共同決定轉速、流量及揚程的變化。泵可能經過零流量甚至逆流區，正常運轉的單一揚程曲線不足以表示全過程；旋轉動能只能提供初步能量尺度，不能以固定功率除法取代轉速相依的動力方程。本例把全部初始轉動能假想轉成固定水力功率，忽略效率、摩擦及揚程變化，只得到比較時間而非實際滑行停機時間。
高點或停泵後的低壓波可能使局部絕對壓力接近蒸氣壓，液體連續柱的單相假設因此失效。空穴形成與再閉合會改變波速、流量連續性及二次壓峰，不能讓數值解無限制下降到負絕對壓；溶解氣體析出又與純蒸氣空穴具有不同時間尺度。比較必須使用同一溫度下的絕對壓力與蒸氣壓；正的差值只代表此瞬間尚有壓力裕度，不證明所有位置都不空化。
氣室藉由可壓縮氣體吸收或供應水量，氣體壓力與體積沿熱力路徑變化。快速過程可能較接近絕熱，慢過程可能交換更多熱量，實際指數須依設備與時間尺度選擇；接管損失、預充狀態與水位行程也限制可用調壓量，不能只看容器總容積。多方關係必須使用絕對壓力，且本例假設氣體質量固定；未含氣體溶解、熱交換細節及接管水力損失，不構成容器選型。
特徵線方法沿壓力波傳播方向連結水頭與流量，空間和時間步長需與波速相容。為了容納不同管長而插值可能引入數值耗散，造成計算峰值變小且看似穩定；這種人工平滑不能當作物理摩阻的證據，應與實際阻尼和量測頻寬分開評估。本例僅核對單一均勻管段的Courant數；C=1不保證所有非線性邊界或空穴模型都準確，仍需網格收斂與質量守恆檢查。
單次極大壓力與長期重複壓力範圍控制不同的損傷問題。薄壁圓管可把壓力範圍換成名目環向應力範圍，但焊趾、腐蝕坑及支座附近會產生局部集中；疲勞評估還需循環次數、平均應力及細節分類，不能把低於降伏當作無限壽命。本式假設薄壁均勻圓管與名目膜應力，沒有給定疲勞曲線或應力集中係數，因此只算應力範圍，不預測壽命。
procedureEn: A transient calculation needs an initial state satisfying both continuity and energy balance. Flow and boundary levels cannot be chosen independently when they are incompatible. Distributed friction, local valve losses and pump head determine velocity, while the elevation profile determines pressure head at each location. Equal total head loss does not imply the same location of minimum pressure. The Darcy example assumes steady, single-phase full-pipe flow with a separately established friction factor. It does not describe local acceleration as a pressure wave arrives.

Pressure-wave speed depends jointly on water compressibility and radial pipe-wall compliance, so the sound speed in unconfined water is insufficient. A larger diameter-to-thickness ratio generally increases thin steel-wall deformation. Restraint, Poisson coupling, linings and entrained air change effective compliance and dispersion, requiring a wave-speed model consistent with pipe material and installation. The expression is a simplified thin elastic-wall relation without Poisson or end-restraint corrections. It does not directly represent viscoelastic plastic pipes or large trapped-air pockets.

A sudden velocity change redistributes liquid momentum through a pressure wave and wall deformation. The Joukowsky relation connects changes across a single wavefront, while flow direction, reflections, branches and initial pressure remain separate. Its calculated increment is neither absolute pressure nor a universal maximum envelope for every point in the system. This example assumes a rapid change, single-phase liquid and known effective speed. Cavitation, column separation and overlapping waves remain outside the calculation and preclude using it as a valve setting.

The pressure history at a valve depends on wave travel to the upstream boundary and back. Length and wave speed establish this round-trip scale. A constant-head reservoir and a closed end reflect pressure differently, while branches divide waves according to impedance. Representing the entire network by one length can conceal shorter resonant paths through branches. Round-trip time describes propagation along one uniform reach rather than a complete period for any network. Boundary dynamics can also change with valve position and water level.

Total closure duration does not fully describe water hammer because effective flow area is usually nonlinear with stem position. Small movement near closure can produce the largest flow change, giving two schedules with equal duration different peaks. A slow-change estimate helps isolate inertia but cannot replace actual valve characteristics and reflected waves. The expression is a scale comparison for a simple reservoir-to-valve main with approximately uniform deceleration and slow closure. It is not a guaranteed peak bound or a recommended closure time.

After power loss a pump does not stop instantaneously. Rotor and liquid-column inertia jointly determine speed, discharge and head. The machine can pass through zero flow and possibly reverse flow, beyond a single normal operating curve. Rotational energy supplies a preliminary scale, but division by fixed hydraulic power cannot replace the speed-dependent dynamic equation. This example hypothetically converts all initial rotational energy into fixed hydraulic power, omitting efficiency, friction and changing head. Its time is a comparison scale, not actual coastdown duration.

At elevated points or after pump shutdown, a low-pressure wave can bring absolute pressure near vapor pressure and invalidate a continuous single-phase column. Cavity formation and collapse alter wave speed, continuity and secondary pressure peaks. A numerical solution must not extend without limit into negative absolute pressure, while dissolved-gas release has different time scales from pure vapor cavities. Compare absolute pressure and vapor pressure at the same temperature. A positive difference indicates a margin at that instant only, not absence of cavitation everywhere.

An air vessel absorbs or supplies water through compression of its gas volume. Pressure and volume evolve along a thermodynamic path: rapid events may approach adiabatic behavior, while slow events permit more heat transfer. The exponent depends on equipment and time scale, and connector losses, precharge condition and water travel constrain usable storage beyond the vessel’s gross volume. The polytropic relation uses absolute pressure and assumes constant gas mass here. It omits gas dissolution, detailed heat transfer and connecting-pipe losses and is not a vessel selection.

The method of characteristics links head and discharge along wave-propagation directions, requiring compatible spatial and temporal increments. Interpolation used to accommodate different pipe lengths can introduce numerical damping, reducing peaks and making results appear stable. Such artificial smoothing is not evidence of physical friction and must be assessed separately from real damping and measurement bandwidth. The example checks the Courant number for one uniform reach only. C=1 does not guarantee accuracy for nonlinear boundaries or cavity models, so convergence and mass balance remain necessary.

A single extreme pressure and repeated pressure ranges govern different damage mechanisms. A thin circular shell converts pressure range into nominal hoop-stress range, but weld toes, corrosion pits and supports introduce local concentrations. Fatigue assessment also needs cycle counts, mean stress and detail classification; stress below yield does not establish infinite service life. The expression assumes a uniform thin circular shell and nominal membrane stress. No fatigue curve or concentration factor is specified, so it calculates stress range without predicting life.
evidence: 建立一張包含流量、基準高程及損失項的能量帳，標示哪些資料為量測、哪些為假設；要求相鄰管段交界的水頭與流量相容後才比較瞬變情境。
比較相同直徑下兩種壁厚的計算波速，再列出公式未涵蓋的約束與含氣條件；以多測點到時共同檢驗參數，不用單一峰值選定波速。
用同一初始水頭分別畫出正負速度擾動的第一波，標出增量與總量。再說明哪些邊界反射必須由瞬變求解器補足，保持教學估算與運轉指令分離。
製作一段水庫至閥門與一段含支線管路的時間距離圖，逐一標明反射邊界。使用到時順序辨認模型結構，再用幅值評估阻抗與損失參數。
比較兩條總時間相同但末段速度不同的假設閥位曲線，說明需加入哪一份流量係數資料才能計算。報告只討論敏感度，不把結果寫成現場閥門設定。
evidenceEn: Prepare an energy ledger containing flow, datum and losses, marking measured and assumed quantities. Require compatible head and flow at adjacent pipe interfaces before comparing transient scenarios.
Compare two wall thicknesses at the same diameter and list omitted restraint and air conditions. Test the parameters using arrivals at multiple sensors rather than selecting speed from one peak.

Draw the first waves from positive and negative velocity disturbances using one initial head, distinguishing increments from totals. Identify reflections requiring a transient solver and keep the teaching estimate separate from operating instructions.

Prepare time-distance diagrams for a reservoir-to-valve reach and a branched main, labeling every reflecting boundary. Use arrival order to assess model structure before using amplitudes to assess impedance and losses.

Compare hypothetical schedules with equal duration but different final travel rates, identifying the flow-coefficient data needed for calculation. Report sensitivity without converting the outcome into field valve settings.
pitfalls: 若初始水頭線不閉合，數值模型可能在尚未操作閥門前就產生人造波動；這種啟動誤差會被誤判成管線反射或真實水錘。
將壓力增量誤當總壓力可能漏掉高初始靜壓；反過來把理想正壓升套到所有位置，又會忽視上游或高點可能出現的負壓。
只將整體關閉時間拉長，卻保留末段突關，仍可能產生強烈壓升；模型若把閥位直接當流量比例，會錯誤預測緩閉措施已奏效。
以表壓直接與蒸氣壓相比會錯置空化判斷，截掉所有負表壓也會消除真實低壓歷程；錯誤的空穴閉合模型可能低估隨後更高的壓峰。
粗網格的人工耗散可能掩蓋短時壓峰，讓保護設備看似足夠；只看求解器沒有發散，不能證明尖峰或水柱分離已被解析。
pitfallsEn: An inconsistent initial hydraulic grade can create artificial oscillations before any valve action. Such startup errors may then be misidentified as physical reflections or actual water hammer.

Treating the increment as total pressure overlooks a high initial static pressure. Applying the ideal positive surge everywhere also misses low-pressure behavior at upstream locations or elevated points.

Increasing overall duration while retaining abrupt final closure can still create a strong surge. A model that equates valve position with flow fraction may incorrectly predict that a slow-closing measure is effective.

Comparing gauge pressure directly with vapor pressure misclassifies cavitation, while clipping all negative gauge pressure erases real low-pressure behavior. An incorrect cavity-collapse model can underestimate the larger peak that follows.

Artificial damping on a coarse grid can hide short pressure peaks and make protective equipment appear sufficient. The absence of solver divergence does not prove that peaks or column separation have been resolved.

related.title: 大口徑輸水管施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」與「低壓與水柱分離機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大口徑輸水管施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification" and "Low pressure and column separation mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Large-diameter water-main construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦波傳播、邊界反射與輸水瞬變驗證；大口徑輸水管施工則以路線、管床、接頭與大管施工階段傳力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on wave propagation, boundary reflections and water-main transient verification; Large-diameter water-main construction centres on alignment, bedding, joints and staged load transfer in large mains, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「穩態水頭基線」與「縱斷面與局部壓力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大口徑輸水管施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Steady hydraulic baseline” and “Alignment and local pressure”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Large-diameter water-main construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Differential settlement and joint rotation mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 長距離輸水管水錘分析
history.titleEn: Water-hammer analysis for long water mains
history.text: 大型輸水工程的知識由管殼設計逐漸延伸到供水韌性與量測校核。美國墾務局壓力管專論的初版於1949年發行，現存修訂版提供歷史機理參照；2020年EPANET手冊則說明配水管網延時分析。紐約於2025年公告德拉瓦繞道須重新採購接通工程，因此本課不將其寫成已完工案例。莫卡辛系統另呈現老舊鋼管與支座更新議題。所有課內算例為獨立假設，未移植上述工程的操作參數。
history.textEn: Knowledge of large water conduits has expanded from shell design to supply resilience and measurement validation. Reclamation first issued its penstock monograph in 1949; its available revision is a historical mechanics reference. The 2020 EPANET manual addresses extended-period distribution modeling. New York announced a new procurement process for Delaware bypass connection in 2025, so this course does not describe it as completed. Moccasin supplies a separate aging-pipe and support-renewal comparison. Every lesson calculation uses independent assumptions rather than operating parameters from those projects.
